newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Virgin unlikely to take Nigeria Airways stake.
newsitem.headline: Virgin unlikely to take Nigeria Airways stake.

text.p: Virgin Atlantic Airways of Britain is not expected to acquire a stake in debt-ridden Nigeria Airways, industry sources said on Monday.

They were responding to reports in the Lagos newspaper Thisday on Monday that the ailing national carrier was being restructured by the Nigerian government to give Virgin Atlantic a block share of 40 percent as well as management control.

"We have been approached; we get dozens of approaches from airlines all over the world about potential deals given that we have a London Heathrow operation," said a Virgin Atlantic spokesman, adding "It is very unlikely that Virgin will follow all of them up."
Nigeria Airways is plagued by a debt burden, which has led to a spate of seizures of its planes abroad.

But aviation minister Air Commodore Ita Udo-Imeh said at a Nigeria Airways staff merit award ceremony in the capital Abuja last week that the airline was about to boost its fleet and to conclude cooperation arrangement with a European airline.
Thisday said the European carrier was Virgin Atlantic and that the government had agreed to all the proposals made by the airline in negotiations to revitalise Nigeria Airways.
Because of its problems, Nigeria Airways has reduced its flights on the lucrative Lagos-London route to a trickle, leaving it mainly to British Airways which operates daily flights to Lagos.
